form_analysis.feedback: Good concise salicylic peel aftercare form with clear time-phased instructions. Specifically addresses acne and pore concerns which are salicylic acid's primary benefits. More streamlined than the glycolic acid form but covers essential care points. Could be enhanced with more detailed timelines and specific product guidance for acne-prone skin.

form_data.treatment_purpose: Thank you for choosing a Salicylic Peel, a chemical exfoliation treatment designed to improve skin texture, reduce acne, and minimise pores.
form_data.introduction: Proper aftercare is essential to ensure optimal results, support healing, and minimise complications.

sections.title: Normal Reactions
sections.content: Mild redness, tingling, or warmth in the treated area is normal and usually subsides within a few hours. Temporary dryness or slight flaking may occur.

sections.title: Avoid Touching
sections.content: Do not rub, scratch, or pick at the treated area. Keep your hands clean and avoid applying makeup immediately after treatment.

sections.title: Skin Care
sections.content: Cleanse gently using a mild, non-alcoholic cleanser. Apply a gentle, fragrance-free moisturiser to keep the skin hydrated. Avoid scrubs, exfoliants, or other harsh skincare products.

sections.title: Sun Protection
sections.content: Your skin will be more sensitive after a peel. Avoid direct sun exposure and always use a broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher.

sections.title: Observation
sections.content: Mild redness, flaking, or peeling may occur as your skin renews. Temporary dryness or tightness is normal.

sections.title: Lifestyle & Care
sections.content: Avoid hot showers, saunas, or steam rooms to prevent irritation. Continue using gentle, non-comedogenic moisturisers. Avoid makeup on areas with peeling skin until fully healed.

sections.title: Results
sections.content: Gradual improvement in skin texture, clarity, and brightness may be observed over several weeks. Multiple sessions may be recommended depending on your treatment plan.

sections.title: Continued Care
sections.content: Maintain gentle skincare and sun protection. Avoid harsh chemical products such as retinoids or strong acids unless cleared by your provider.

emergency_guidance.title: When to Contact Us
emergency_guidance.content: Contact your provider immediately if you experience:
items: Severe or persistent redness, swelling, or pain.
Signs of infection such as pus, warmth, or fever.
Any unusual or concerning reactions such as excessive peeling or blistering.

long_term_care.title: Long-Term Care
items: Maintain daily use of gentle cleansers and moisturisers.
Protect your skin from sun exposure using SPF 30 or higher.
Attend follow-up appointments if recommended to monitor results and plan further treatments.
